gate_type: CORRECTION gate — R1 reset must clear ASSY domain hold/freeze state (R1-C01)
objective: Make the canonical TIPA session reset clear the ASSY domain hold/freeze state: AssyExecutionBridge.reset(...) must clear the held sub-line ids for the scopes it resets, while preserving the frozen G22 same-run-id reset semantics (same run identity, same runtime objects, time back to 0, profile-consistent fresh domain state for all six sub-lines). After reset, the six sub-lines must return to the fresh profile baseline and the next advance must have all six lines participate and progress again. R1 production/profile/scenario/isolation behaviour must be preserved exactly.
explicit_non_objectives: No change to generic G22 lifecycle semantics
No change to the R1 run profile/feed/scenario/targeting semantics
required_deliverables: src/virtual_factory/runcontrol/assy_bridge.py (reset clears the scope's domain hold/freeze state)
tests/test_vnext_r1_production_semantics.py (C01 regression test: advance -> hold one line -> RuntimeSession.reset() -> held ids empty -> advance -> all six participate and progress)
stop_conditions: Clearing the hold state would require changing the frozen G22 reset/lifecycle contract
Correct implementation requires touching outside the allowlist materially
The accepted R1 production/profile/scenario/isolation behaviour cannot be preserved

acceptance_criteria.description: AssyExecutionBridge.reset clears the held sub-line ids for the reset scopes
Same-run-id reset semantics preserved (identity + runtime objects + profile-consistent fresh baseline)
After reset + advance, all six sub-lines participate and progress again
R1 production/profile/scenario/isolation behaviour preserved (R1 tests + full suite + canonical baseline green)
Working tree clean and branch/head pushed; no R2 started
